title: Design System: 工业数据采集管理平台

heading.purpose: Panel titles, table headers, button labels. Always uppercase, always Inter semibold.

body.purpose: Chinese body text, descriptions, cell content. 0.875rem, 1.6 line-height.

kpi.purpose: All numeric values: stats, Z-Scores, percentages. Rajdhani monospace, tight spacing.

shadows.name: tooltip
shadows.purpose: Map hover tooltips. Large blur to separate from dark map bg.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default state transitions: hover, focus, toggle.

motion.name: fade-in-up
motion.purpose: Card and element entrance animations. opacity + translateY(12px→0).

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: Primary container. Semi-transparent dark bg with backdrop blur. Used for dashboard panels, stat cards, analytics blocks.
components.css: .ds-glass-card { background: rgba(10,14,22,0.82); backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.2); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.2); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; overflow: visible; }.ds-glass-label { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #94a3b8; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; margin-bottom: 8px; }.ds-glass-content { font-family: 'PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #e8eaef; }

components.name: Stat Card

components.css: .ds-stat-card { background: rgba(10,14,22,0.82); backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.2); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.2); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; animation: ds-fade-in-up 0.3s ease-out forwards; }.ds-stat-label { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #64748b; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; margin-bottom: 4px; }.ds-stat-value { font-family: Rajdhani, DIN, monospace; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }.ds-stat-unit { font-family: Rajdhani, DIN, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #64748b; margin-left: 4px; }.ds-stat-blue { color: #3b82f6; }.ds-stat-green { color: #34d399; }.ds-stat-orange { color: #fb923c; }.ds-stat-red { color: #f87171; } @keyframes ds-fade-in-up { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

components.name: Clear Button
components.description: Destructive clear/acknowledge action. Red tint background, subtle hover intensify.
components.css: .ds-btn-clear { background: rgba(248,113,113,0.15); color: #f87171; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 4px 10px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.75rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); }.ds-btn-clear:hover { background: rgba(248,113,113,0.25); }.ds-btn-clear:disabled { opacity: 0.3; cursor: not-allowed; }.ds-btn-clear:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f87171; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Dropdown
components.description: Dark dropdown selector. Fixed-position portal with heavy shadow. Used for refresh rate and filter selects.
components.html: 5s
components.css: .ds-dropdown { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 10px; background: #111827; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #e8eaef; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); }.ds-dropdown:hover { background: #1a2332; }.ds-dropdown-label { font-family: Rajdhani, DIN, monospace; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }.ds-dropdown-arrow { width: 12px; height: 12px; transition: transform 0.2s; }.ds-dropdown-panel { position: fixed; background: #111827; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); z-index: 99999; overflow: hidden; min-width: 5rem; }.ds-dropdown-option { padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #94a3b8; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s, background-color 0.15s; }.ds-dropdown-option:hover { color: #e8eaef; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); }.ds-dropdown-option.active { color: #3b82f6; background: rgba(59,130,246,0.1); }

components.css: .ds-sidebar { width: 208px; flex-shrink: 0; background: #0c0f14; border-right: 1px solid #1a2440; display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 12px 0; }.ds-sidebar-section { padding: 8px 16px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.6rem; color: #94a3b8; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; }.ds-sidebar-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 16px; margin: 0 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'PingFang SC',sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #94a3b8; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); }.ds-sidebar-item:hover { color: #e8eaef; background: #0e1628; }.ds-sidebar-item.active { background: #162240; color: #e8eaef; }.ds-sidebar-icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex-shrink: 0; opacity: 0.7; }

components.css: .ds-table-wrap { max-height: 256px; overflow-y: auto; }.ds-table-wrap::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 4px; }.ds-table-wrap::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }.ds-table-wrap::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #2a3d55; border-radius: 2px; }.ds-table-wrap::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: #3d5580; }.ds-table { width: 100%; font-size: 0.875rem; border-collapse: collapse; }.ds-table thead { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 10; background: #0a0f18; }.ds-table th { padding: 8px 0; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.7rem; color: #64748b; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: left; }.ds-table th:last-child { text-align: right; }.ds-table td { padding: 8px 0; font-size: 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(128,128,128,0.12); }.ds-table td:first-child { color: #e8eaef; font-family: 'PingFang SC',sans-serif; }.ds-table tbody tr:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); }.ds-table-num { text-align: right; font-family: Rajdhani, DIN, monospace; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #94a3b8; }.ds-table-red { color: #f87171; }.ds-table-green { color: #34d399; }.ds-table-orange { color: #fb923c; }

narrative.overview: 这是一个为工业运维控制室设计的仪表盘系统。设计语言立足于数据本身的物理感——3D 视差地图提供了跨越省界的空间纵深，玻璃面板营造出控制台前的仪表分层。深色画布不是风格选择，而是功能需求：发光的数据在近乎黑色的背景下获得最大可读性。系统刻意保持设计元素的克制：没有渐变色文字、没有大面积毛玻璃堆叠、没有彩色侧边装饰条。每一种颜色承载一个编码含义，颜色只出现在需要传达状态的地方。
keyCharacteristics: 玻璃面板不叠加阴影——深度来自 backdrop-filter blur + 1px 透明白边框
Inter（标签）+ Rajdhani（数字）+ 中文字体（正文），三字体上限
状态色编码：绿/橙/红/蓝，每种 ≤15% 表面占比
3D 视差地图作为签名字面，CSS perspective + transform 产生真实空间位移

rules.name: The Canvas Depth Rule
rules.body: 背景只用四层（canvas-deep / canvas / panel / panel-raised），禁止引入第五层或中间色调。深度通过层的堆叠关系传达，不通过单独的阴影或渐变。

rules.name: The No-Warm-Neutral Rule
rules.body: 任何带有 40-100° 色相的非零彩度中性色都被禁止。画布是纯冷暗色的，不是暖色的。温暖感来自数据的发光，不是来自背景的染色。

rules.name: The Three-Font Cap Rule
rules.body: Inter + Rajdhani + 中文字体，这三个就是全部。不引入第四种字体系列。仪表盘不是字体展览，是数据呈现工具。

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: 除 dropdown 和 tooltip 外，所有表面在自由状态下都没有盒阴影。深度通过色调和 blur 传达。

dos: 用四层画布色调建立空间层次，不引入新色
用 Rajdhani 字体显示一切数值数据，Inter 显示一切标签标题
保持 glass 卡片无阴影扁平状态——深度来自 blur 和色调
用颜色编码状态：绿=正确、橙=注意、红=紧急，每种状态色 ≤15% 表面
donts: 不使用任何暖色调中性背景色（cream / sand / beige / warm-gray）
不在 glass 卡片上叠加盒阴影——blur + 1px 白边框已经足够
不引入第四种字体系列——Inter + Rajdhani + 中文字体是上限
不在 glass 卡片上叠加 backdrop-filter 超过 2 层
不使用渐变文字或彩色左边框作为视觉强调
